biography.plain_text: Randy Beth Breitman is an American real estate broker working in Florida and New Jersey. Raised on the Jersey shore, she studied business administration at Brookdale College and began selling property in 1993. Her career included Weichert and Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices before she established Randy B Realty in West Palm Beach.

long_biography.plain_text:
Real estate broker Randy Beth Breitman has taken part in community organisations. She served on the board of the National Multiple Sclerosis Society's Women on the Move and on the Monmouth County Children's Advocacy Center committee. She and her husband, Steve, have supported Friendship Circle's work with people with disabilities.

Her son, Joshua Rosenblatt, joined her brokerage after studying investment finance at Lynn University and obtaining his real estate licence. His preparation covered valuation and market analysis; she also highlighted his experience selling through online platforms he helped create. Mother and son subsequently worked together on property sales.
